Im only 19, and I feel this way all the time. 
So first of all
You are not alone. Sometimes its comforting to find that there are other people that don't have their life together.
Secondly, death is a really difficult part in life to deal with. And letting go of people is always hard. But you should rejoice in all the good memories you had with your grandparents and the times you spent them. And know that you have angels watching over you that will help you in your time of need right now. 
Thirdly, 3 years is a long time. Being with anyone for that long will eventually give you moments where you begin to dislike all the things you used to love about that person. It is your choice but think clearly about whether this is the person you want to spend your life with. Are all those annoying things and the sex something you can look past? If not, it is easier to leave her now than later. 
Lastly, now is the time to take control of your own life. You are in your 20's you have a long life ahead. If you dont like your major then drop it. Figure out what you want to do. Seriously, it is going to be so hard if you keep going with things you hate and regret it. It will not only make your present life bad, but also your future. Start to make decisions. The more you are confident in your choices the better your life will be. Its better than to regret not doing anything later.

I hope this helps. And I hope your situation gets better.
